title: The Daily Figure on Advance-Booked Equipment Rental and Demo Agreements Handed In Late
content:
Kit booked well ahead was kit the shop had promised to somebody else, and where an agreement of the Equipment Rental and Demo line was taken far enough in advance the days it stays out beyond its date are charged at the hire rate raised, rather than at the package's own daily late fee.

## The rule

Where the agreement was recorded at least the package's advance booking period in days before the collection date, and it was written for at least the package's multi-day threshold in days, the daily figure is the package's multi-day day rate raised by the late hand-in uplift and rounded half up to two decimal places. The late hand-in uplift is 35 per cent.

Where the agreement was recorded at least the package's advance booking period in days before the collection date, but it was written for fewer days than the package's multi-day threshold, the daily figure is the package's shop day rate raised by the same 35 per cent and rounded half up to two decimal places.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the daily figure.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Advance booking period, days | Multi-day threshold, days | Multi-day day rate | Shop day rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 7 | 3 | 27.00 USD | 32.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 7 | 3 | 39.00 USD | 46.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 7 | 3 | 53.00 USD | 62.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 10 | 3 | 68.00 USD | 79.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 10 | 2 | 82.00 USD | 95.00 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 30 | 1 | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## The two conditions in combination

| Recorded at least the advance period before collection | Written for at least the multi-day threshold | Daily figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the multi-day day rate raised by 35 per cent |
| yes | no | the shop day rate raised by 35 per cent |
| no | either way | nothing under this heading changes it |

## Worked figures on hypothetical agreements

Take the Sport Ski & Board Rental, whose advance period is 7 days, whose threshold is 3 days, whose multi-day day rate is 53.00 USD and whose shop day rate is 62.00 USD.

- Recorded 9 days before the collection date and written for 4 days: both conditions hold, so the daily figure is 53.00 USD raised by 35 per cent, which is 71.55 USD.
- Recorded 8 days before the collection date and written for 2 days: 2 days is fewer than the threshold of 3, so the daily figure is 62.00 USD raised by 35 per cent, which is 83.70 USD.
- Recorded 5 days before the collection date: 5 days is fewer than the advance period of 7, so nothing under this heading changes the daily figure.

The lead is counted from the date the reservation was recorded to the collection date; a lead exactly equal to the package's advance period meets the test, and a number of days the agreement was written for exactly equal to the package's threshold meets that one.
